audit.whatIsWrong: diff read 'FAV' while diffRating was 6/10, tone was the even-lane amber, and report[14] said 'Even matchup'. The level chart also disagreed with the packet on rows 1, 3 and 6 — and with its own whys text.
audit.why: 52.13% over 610 games is an even lane. whys[1] says 'Still even', whys[3] says any hook-in is suicidal (yours), whys[6] says it 'lands back at even' — exactly the packet chart [Skill, Skill, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Skill, Heimerdinger, Skill].
audit.corrected: diff FAV -> EVEN; win[1]/phases[1] -> Skill, win[3]/phases[3] -> Heimerdinger, win[6]/phases[6] -> Skill, with phase whys rewritten to say what each row actually is.

audit.why: Four spikes present and correct: your 2-3 wall, your 4-5 nest peak, his level-6 R-into-hook CC chain, his 2+ item tank scaling.
audit.corrected: Kept. phases[3].why now names the 4-5 nest peak instead of a generic 'lane-control window' line.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers on any Nautilus ability, and Titan's Wrath was never mentioned at all — the burst-absorbing shield that decides whether your commit lands. dontsFull[1] was titled 'Eat his passive root chain' but its body described spending one of your own spells.
audit.why: Dredge Line is 14/13/12/11/10s and 1150 range — the single longest cooldown in his kit and the whole reason the lane is playable. Titan's Wrath is a flat 12s shield that also makes his autos tick damage. Staggering Blow roots on his first attack on a target, which is what the hook is setting up. Riptide (7s at rank 1) slows so you cannot walk out.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries 14s Dredge Line, 12s Titan's Wrath and your 11s grenade; dosFull[2].d names the shield as the thing to bait; dontsFull[1].d names Staggering Blow; wants.foe[0] names the full Dredge Line -> Riptide -> Staggering Blow chain.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect claims the matchup 'never names any of Nautilus's abilities'. That is only half true — Dredge Line is named throughout the full layer, but Titan's Wrath, Riptide and Staggering Blow appear nowhere in either layer.
audit.why: The generic 'his passive auto-root' and 'his R' phrasings read as filler and cost the reader the ability to track anything.
audit.corrected: Titan's Wrath, Riptide and Staggering Blow are each named once, in the field where they are actionable.

edits.before: Three turrets make your half of lane a no-entry zone. Only take the trade when Nautilus's Dredge Line is down.
edits.after: Still even — Staggering Blow hurts if he reaches you, but Dredge Line is 14s at rank 1, so trade in that gap.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Dredge Line's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Peak nest: three banked charges plus the grenade stun make a hook-in suicidal — he cannot all-in through full beam DPS and CC.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Nautilus carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Tank HP and resists shrug off your beams — you out-siege and out-zone but never out-kill him, so it settles back to even.

edits.before: - Nautilus Dredge Line: matchup-defining — His only engage. E-stun/dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Dredge Line: 14s at rank 1 — his only engage, and the whole lane lives inside that gap. - Titan's Wrath: 12s flat shield — bait it off before you burst. - Your grenade: 11s — held reactively, never spent as poke.

edits.before: Nautilus wastes Dredge Line (Hook) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Titan's Wrath shields on a flat 12s — poke it off before you commit.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Staggering Blow roots on his first auto — the hook exists to set it up.

edits.before: Land the one Q hook to drag you off your turrets and onto his passive auto-root for a free trade
edits.after: Land Dredge Line to drag you off your turrets, then Riptide slows and Staggering Blow roots you in place

notes: Packet defect 'never names any of Nautilus's abilities' is partly wrong — Dredge Line is named all through the full layer. Titan's Wrath, Riptide and Staggering Blow genuinely were absent and are now each named once. Not asserted (kit is silent): whether Depth Charge can be blocked by standing behind minions, and whether your grenade stun interrupts the hook's travel — neither is in Riot's text and neither claim appears in the rewrite.
